title: qatarenergy cancels gas deliveries italys edison until early november 2026 08 28
text:
MILAN, Aug 28 (Reuters) - QatarEnergy ​has notified Italian utility Edison (EDNn.MI)
, opens new tab
, one of its biggest ‌customers in Europe, that it has extended a force majeure suspension period on liquefied natural gas (LNG) deliveries until early November due to the U.S.-Iran war.
The ​Italian utility received the updated notification from Qatar on ​Thursday, sources said.
The Gulf supplier will not be able ⁠to deliver five LNG cargoes scheduled for delivery between the end ​of September and beginning of November, Edison said in a message ​posted on Italy's GME platform for the gas market.
That will bring the total number of canceled cargoes to 29, equal to 3.8 billion cubic ​meters of gas, Edison said in a press release issued ​later on Friday.
Edison confirmed its ability to source alternative gas for all its ‌customers ⁠and its ability to fully meet its commercial commitments.
"As of August 28, 2026, Edison's volumes replaced at the Adriatic LNG terminal amounted to 21 LNG cargoes, corresponding to approximately 2 billion ​cubic meters of ​natural gas," it ⁠said.
QatarEnergy stopped supplying the Italian group in April due to the disruptions caused by the U.S.-Iran ​conflict.
Edison, a unit of French energy group EDF, ​holds ⁠a long-term contract with QatarEnergy for the supply of 6.4 billion cubic meters of natural gas per year to Italy, around 10% ⁠of ​the country's total consumption.
The contract, which has ​been in force since 2009, has a total duration of 25 years.
